expressions.name: Spark
expressions.expression:
count = static.sparkCount
button = buttonVars.sparkON
selfBuzz = buttonVars.selfBuzz

if selfBuzz == 1 and button == 1 then
    "DO:Spark" = 1
endif

if selfBuzz == 0 and button == 1 then
   if static.sparkCount == 2 then
      "DO:Spark" = 0
   endif
   if static.sparkCount == 1 then
       "DO:Spark" = 1
   endif
   if static.sparkCount == 0 then
       "DO:Spark" = 1
   endif
   static.sparkCount = static.sparkCount + 1
   if static.sparkCount > 2 then
       static.sparkCount = 0
   endif
endif

if button == 0 then
   "DO:Spark" = 0
endif    

count = static.sparkCount
spark = "DO:Spark"

expressions.name: LOX_Vent_Control
expressions.expression:
// Control the LOX Vent, take manual and PID inputs
pid_input = "PID:LOX_PID".OUT
man_input = buttonVars.manualLOXVent
man_input = man_input or buttonVars.ventBoth

if ((pid_input > 0) OR (man_input > 0)) == 1 then
    vent = 1
else
    if man_input == 0 then
        if pid_input > 0 then
            vent = 1
        else
            vent = 0
        endif
    endif
endif

"DO:LOXVent" = vent

expressions.name: Fuel_Vent_Control
expressions.expression:
// Control the Fuel Vent, take manual and PID inputs
pid_input = "PID:Fuel_PID".OUT
man_input = buttonVars.manualFuelVent
man_input = man_input or buttonVars.ventBoth

if ((pid_input > 0) OR (man_input > 0)) == 1 then
    vent = 1
else
    if man_input == 0 then
        if pid_input == 1 then
            vent = 1
        else
            vent = 0
        endif
    endif
endif

"DO:FuelVent" = vent

expressions.name: LOXFuelOutletControl
expressions.expression:
// Controls individually and together the LOX and Fuel outlet valves

LOXOut = buttonVars.LOXOutEn
FuelOut = buttonVars.FuelOutEn
both    = buttonVars.BothOutEn
goLOX = 0
goFuel = 0

if (LOXOut == 1) or (both == 1) then
    goLOX = 1
endif
"DO:LOXOUT" = goLOX

if (FuelOut == 1) or (both == 1) then
    goFuel = 1
endif
"DO:FuelOUT" = goFuel
